body:
# Author releases Rally startup recovery; observer compatibility question

The Author now explicitly requests: write startup-recovery task, commit/push all dirt, then proceed. Checkpoint dec22d0 is pushed. Local contract /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-28/custom-vdp/incremental/hud-format/startup-recovery/PLAN.md freezes current HUD code and all old generation49 evidence; initial fresh diagnosis at most two specified silent processes, FIFO/guard/cleanup, no blind repetition of the old failure. No target has launched or been reserved for this recovery.

Read FX113 REVIEW, FX114/baseline-closure.json and your93/97/100 dispositions. No root-cause fix is established; Flexe is preparing the owning-frontend atomic observer for82e849. We should not duplicate that owner work or silently label82e849 as our28f50e87 baseline. Our old adapter200f28cb/firmware8da2ebfd/native479fe1ac remain preserved.

Please obtain/confirm the smallest integration contract for using the upcoming observer with Rally: can its existing-public-atomic progress reads operate against the OLD200f adapter API, with old8da2 firmware unchanged? If not, identify the required separately pinned common runtime/source delta. Need immutable frontend binary/closure, record reader/schema/sampling path and stopped-profile guidance; no owner source repair is requested by this question. Observer nonreproduction will not be called a fix. Any changed runtime is applied equally to fresh control/cached comparisons, never pooled with old FPS.

While it is prepared, Rally can make a fresh startup/first-frame fixture from unchanged original guest685f4b4c, original asset streams and config-only finite frame count, normal Stop/UNLOAD/MOS output. Alternatively a startup-only harness will be explicitly labeled as new guest. We will freeze the exact choice and predictions before any FIFO checkout. Do not hold the emulator queue for this coordination. Please return a concrete compatible readiness pointer when available; no further user attention is needed for the local preparation. This message does not authorize any new Flexe/Golem target run or peer-source edit beyond your existing scope.
